title: Multimodal spatial transcriptomics redefines cortical pathology in Huntington’s disease
title_zh: 多模态空间转录组学重新定义亨廷顿病皮质病理
abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is caused by CAG expansion in the huntingtin gene (HTT), yet how somatic repeat instability and HTT inclusions relate to selective cell loss in the human brain remains unclear. We have developed a multimodal spatial transcriptomics approach that enables the definition of transcriptional programs with subcellular resolution, somatic CAG repeat lengths, and eight other pathology markers, including HTT inclusions, in every cell of intact brain sections. Imaging 428,173 cells in the control and HD cortex revealed the selective vulnerability of layer 5-6 (L5-6) near-projecting (NP) neurons and L6b deep-layer excitatory neurons, which undergo a >50% loss that is closely linked to large somatic repeat expansions (>450 ± 55 CAGs). Intranuclear inclusions were most prevalent at intermediate somatic repeat expansions (250-350 CAGs) and were associated with broader transcriptional changes than somatic repeat expansion alone. These data provide a comprehensive resource and establish a general framework for connecting repeat expansion and protein pathology across diverse cell types.
abstract_zh: 亨廷顿病（HD）由亨廷顿蛋白基因（HTT）中的CAG扩增引起，但体细胞重复不稳定性和HTT包涵体与人脑中选择性细胞死亡的关系仍不清楚。我们开发了一种多模态空间转录组学方法，可在完整脑切片的每个细胞中，以亚细胞分辨率定义转录程序、体细胞CAG重复长度以及八种其他病理标记，包括HTT包涵体。对对照组和HD皮质共成像428,173个细胞，发现第5-6层（L5-6）近投射（NP）神经元和第6b层深层兴奋性神经元的选择性易损性，这些细胞失去超过50%，与大体细胞重复扩增（>450 ± 55 CAGs）密切相关。核内包涵体在中等体细胞重复扩增（250-350 CAGs）时最为常见，并与单独体细胞重复扩增相比，伴随更广泛的转录变化。这些数据提供了一个全面的资源，并建立了一个通用框架，用于连接不同细胞类型中的重复扩增和蛋白质病理。
